model.source: Manual transitionInvariant: dependency spinner false→true, bounds.width, explicit semantic API invariants, absolute tolerance 0.01px.
model.compiler: One new atomic RuleIR using existing approximately-equals. No Predicate Engine changes or Button-specific runtime branch.
model.evidence: Two bounded sequential same-session snapshots of the same instance, page, representation and variant; same manual hash, Product/modes and external context. Recomputed before/after facts, never trust exported derived temporal results.
model.externalContext: Fixed ancestor dimensions, layout parameters, variable modes/bindings, rotation/linear transform, child order, sibling dimensions and root placement constraints. Derived HUG/group dimensions and translation excluded. GRID ancestors unsupported.
model.missing: Raw Engine unknown retained; Editor presents one Not executed coverage gap with reason, not duplicate unknown or false pass.
model.ui: Remember before, normal selected-instance check after, clear pair. Pair session-only; import resets it. No Figma mutation or automatic Loading switch. Editable typed constraint fields preserve manual roundtrip.
model.legacy: Opt-in transitionFactsVersion=1. Previous r21 manual/compiled/core archived; old reports replay exactly.
model.limitsOfProof: Only observed endpoints and captured context are compared. This does not establish event history or infer runtime front-end behavior. Code adapter coverage is not claimed.
